step_by_step_reasoning: The architecture shows a B2B multi-tenant construction site monitoring and image obfuscation pipeline built on AWS serverless services. 1. Cameras from construction sites globally upload images via SFTP (AWS Transfer Family). 2. AWS Transfer Family stores these images into an Ingestion S3 Bucket. 3. S3 triggers an Instant Lambda function which calls Amazon Rekognition to immediately identify and blur faces and license plates. 4. Parallel/Batch processing runs nightly via a Batch Lambda function invoking Amazon Rekognition Custom Labels (trained on construction workers with helmets/vests). 5. Processed images from both instant and batch workflows are saved into a Platform S3 Bucket. 6. Tenants access the obfuscated images and construction time-lapses via a Web Application hosted on/connected to the Platform S3 bucket.
